texts: At sundown a Keeper cleans the lantern glass with a soft cloth.
The Keeper fills the reservoir from the day's flask.
When a station needs warding, the Keeper scatters ground feathers around the lantern.
In winter the Keeper sprinkles salt-bloom into the reservoir.

fields.sentence: At sundown a Keeper cleans the lantern glass with a soft cloth.

review.notes: 'the lantern glass' takes the car-engine possessor/part route (glass + PartOf lantern) and 'soft' stays a separate descriptive atom, both as Compound concepts directs; the capitalized common noun 'Keeper' rightly gets no Name atom and the simple present rightly gets no status atom.

The capitalized singular common-noun label 'the Keeper' correctly takes a definite witness with no Name atom, and the simple present correctly gets no status atom. Patient on the wick fits the physical-change test, and no wick-lantern part-whole is invented.

fields.sentence: The Keeper fills the reservoir from the day's flask.

review.notes: Capitalized singular label "the Keeper" correctly treated as a common noun (witness + Member, no Name); bare simple present correctly gets no status atom, and the 's-genitive "the day's flask" correctly takes the opaque Possession rather than PartOf.

fields.sentence: When a station needs warding, the Keeper scatters ground feathers around the lantern.
parse: (: warding_rule (Implication (And (Member $s station) (Member $e need) (Experiencer $e $s) (Stimulus $e warding)) (And (Member (sk_scatter $e) scatter) (Agent (sk_scatter $e) sk_keeper_1) (Theme (sk_scatter $e) (sk_feathers $e)) (Member (sk_feathers $e) feather) (Member (sk_feathers $e) ground) (Location (sk_scatter $e) sk_lantern_1) (During (sk_scatter $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: (Member (sk_feathers $e) feather) types the plural NP 'ground feathers' as a single individual, where a plural set participating in the occurrence takes a group witness (GroupOf ... feather).

(Member (sk_feathers $e) ground) predicates the descriptive participial modifier of the group symbol itself — the group-as-object reading that *Categorical statements* and the plural clause of *Compound concepts* both bar; a descriptive modifier on a plural must distribute to the members.

q2_gaps: a peripheral spatial preposition on an EVENT ('scatters ... around the lantern'): the entity side mandates the surface-preposition head for anything outside in/at/inside/within, but the event side glosses Location only as 'in/at/on ...' and tells you to decide by the question the PP answers ('where'), so whether 'around' takes Location or the preposition-named oblique (Around <event> ...) is unsettled

the role class for 'need' with an inanimate subject: it passes the progressive test for stativity but is not psych/perception, and sits next to the Holder class's 'lack' — neither of the two carve-outs that move a transitive subject off Agent clearly covers it
review.notes: The whenever-rule machinery is otherwise right — plain-variable premises, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, STV 1.0 0.9, definite referents typed at top level, no QuantifierPhrase — and the participial 'ground' correctly keeps its surface form rather than lemmatizing to 'grind'. The two issues are one fault: the plural object was individuated as a singleton instead of a group, which then put its modifier on the group symbol.

issues.reason: "ground feathers" is a plural set taking part in the occurrence, which *Coordination & plurals* gives a group witness; (Member (sk_feathers $e) feather) instead says the scattered thing IS one feather — the class-slot use the group rule explicitly forbids ("a group is an individual; it never goes in a class slot") and false of a plural NP.

The half that stands is that under the correct group typing a descriptive modifier must distribute to the members and never ride the group symbol; the half that does not is the charge against the parse as written — with the object typed as a single feather, (Member (sk_feathers $e) ground) is the ordinary licensed two-atom adjective split ("a dented pail"), so the fault is the singular typing already confirmed at index 0.

gaps_confirmed: a peripheral spatial preposition on an EVENT ("scatters ... around the lantern"): the event side glosses Location as in/at/on while the entity side mandates the surface-preposition head for anything outside in/at/inside/within, leaving Location vs (Around <event> ...) unsettled

the subject role for stative "need" with an inanimate subject: it resists the progressive but is neither possession nor psych/perception, so neither carve-out that moves a transitive subject off Agent clearly covers it
new_gaps: a plural object carrying a descriptive modifier INSIDE a rule consequent has no clean licensed form: the group route's per-member distribution would have to nest an (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) inside the consequent's (And ...), a nesting the instruction set illustrates only for seals and for top-level resultatives
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant typing is (GroupOf (sk_feathers $e) feather) in place of (Member (sk_feathers $e) feather); the participial modifier then needs the per-member distribution a plural descriptive modifier requires, for which the instruction set licenses no form inside a rule consequent — filed as the new gap above.
adjudication.notes: The whenever machinery is otherwise right — plain-variable premises, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, STV 1.0 0.9, definite referents typed at top level, no QuantifierPhrase — and "ground" correctly keeps its participial surface form.

fields.sentence: In winter the Keeper sprinkles salt-bloom into the reservoir.

review.notes: 'the Keeper' correctly stays a capitalized-common-noun label (witness + type, no Name atom); bare mass 'salt-bloom' correctly stays a bare class constant while still carrying its compound genus, and 'into' correctly takes the motion-result Goal. Minor observation only: the named-slot cycle table (weekday->week, day-part->day, month->year) has no season entry, so a habitual 'in winter' gets a bare Time symbol and no Every atom.

Capitalized singular kind-word label 'the Keeper' correctly stays a common noun with no Name atom; lighting a wick physically changes it, so Patient is right, and the bare simple present correctly carries no status atom.
